'''Borbala Biro''' (born 1957, in [[Debrecen]]) is a Hungarian [[soil biology|soil biologist]] and lecturer at the [[Gödöllő#Szent István University|Szent-István-University in Gödöllö]].<ref name="bio">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nyirkarasz.hu/kozsegunkrol/hires-karasziak/prof-dr-biro-borbala-ph-d-c-sc |title=Prof Bíró Borbála |language=hu |access-date=2019-08-18}}</ref> She participates in research into the use of [[biofector]]s with the [[University of Hohenheim]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://biofector.info/p-05-cub.html |title=Borbala Biro |website=Biofector |access-date=2019-08-18 |archive-date=2019-05-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190518104931/http://www.biofector.info/p-05-cub.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Biro attended vocational college in [[Kisvárda]]; the Natural Science Faculty of the University of Kossuth Lajos specialising in terrestrial ecology; obtained [[habilitation]] for Plant Cultivation and Horticulture at the West Hungarian University in Mosonmagyaróvár, and a doctorate of the Hungarian Academy of Science.<ref name="bio" /> 

She was a [[Royal Society]] [[postdoctoral]] research fellow at [[Wye College]].<ref name="bio" />
